function_cards.frequency: each player may pay 5 cash to draw at turn start; limit 2 purchases per turn
function_cards.hand_rule: maximum 6 cards; when a seventh card is drawn, discard one held card before receiving it
function_cards.play_cost: playing a function card has no additional cash cost after it is drawn

foreign_relation_rules.source: 數值以 foreign_powers/data/foreign_powers.json 的 relation_scale 為準；這裡是同一組切點的副本，backend/test_backend.py 會逐項比對，對不上就紅燈。
foreign_relation_rules.relation_cards: common foreign relation cards grant +2 to one selected power and are capped at 10
foreign_relation_rules.friendly_unlock: friendly powers add FOREIGN_PERK_CARD_COPIES copies of each perk card to the player deck (communist_riot and red_army_uprising get one extra)
foreign_relation_rules.hostile_filler: hostile powers add three no-effect condemnation cards until relations recover
